summary: Nix research program phase 3: one opus agent reads the 3 audits + 6 scouts + frame and writes the prioritised topic map, decides the artifact set, commissions wave 2 and stages waves 3-4
logs: Map: 172 rows · wave2 6 dives in 3 groups · wave3 6 · wave4 4 · deferred 18 · owner questions 8

conflicts_resolved: 1 Systems iteration: hand-rolled nixpkgs.lib.genAttrs over a literal list plus legacyPackages is the default for A/D/E; flake-parts accepted when importing/exporting flake-parts modules; flake-utils never added (existing use = SHOULD migrate); blueprint recognized, not recommended [shape §3, shift §12, prac §6-7, runs Axis 3]

2 One nixpkgs instance per system: legacyPackages by default, at most one configured import per system in one named binding with the warning-free argument spelling; the rule targets the idiom, not a count [shape §4, runs headline (56 rename warnings), runs Axis 6 (devenv 95.6 s)]

3 Pinning by shape: B takes no nixpkgs input (pkgs as argument, at most nixpkgs-lib), C modules use the consumer's pkgs, A/D pin and document follows; consumers follow library/module/overlay inputs, not cache-served package inputs; Q1 after every lock change; flake-checker crash is a tool limit [shape §2, gen §8, prac §11, fail §3, runs Axis 4]

4 packages is the export of record; overlays.default built from the same package.nix via callPackage, never a second import to apply it; a generated overlay adds exactly one namespace attribute [shape §5, gen §3, prac §9]

5 Formatter of record is nixfmt via pkgs.nixfmt (attribute renamed in nixpkgs 25.11, tool docs followed in 1.3.0); nixfmt-rfc-style/nixfmt-classic/nixpkgs-fmt are findings; an alejandra repo keeps alejandra; exact formatter output is the format-and-lint dive's call [cod §6 §12, shift §5 §11, fail §14, runs Axis 5]

6 Gates: nixfmt check MUST; deadnix --fail --no-lambda-pattern-names with exclusions SHOULD, promoted to MUST at <=1 FP per 1,000 lines on >=5 exemplars; statix advisory, only defect-detector codes (W12, W17/W19, W05 candidates) may back a rule [runs Axis 5, cod §1-2]

7 nixConfig: SHOULD NOT appear; if present MUST hold only the project's own extra-substituters/extra-trusted-public-keys; accept-flake-config never set or passed (MUST) [runs headline, canon survey 3, fail (NixOS/nix#9649), shape §6, gen]

8 Version comes from the project manifest via lib.importTOML (Cargo.toml/pyproject.toml); revision kept out of version (self.shortRev or self.dirtyShortRev or unknown via env/flag); D flakes use upstream version; nix-update inline literals are fine [shape §4 §12, shift]

9 Releases are the project's vX.Y.Z tags pinned as github:owner/repo/vX.Y.Z; FlakeHub optional (default no), tagged only, never mixed with rolling; fleet flakes take no FlakeHub inputs; a generated flake's version is its lock revision [shape §2 §10, gen §12, ocx §4]

10 Non-flake users: flake-compat default.nix SHOULD for A/D, never from edolstra in new code (NixOS vs nix-community picked by dive); callPackage-able package.nix is required anyway [shape §8, canon survey 10, gen §8]

11 Implementations: pinned CppNix is the gate of record; Lix 2.95 a non-blocking --no-build eval leg; floor = oldest non-stub nixVersions.nix_2_* in the pinned channel; no Determinate-only features [runs Axis 7 (nix_2_24 stub), shift §7 §10, cod §15, canon survey 17]

12 Installer and cache: cachix/install-nix-action pinned by full SHA with explicit Nix version; Determinate installers only by intent, never @main; GitHub-Actions store cache (cache-nix-action or magic-nix-cache >=v11, dive picks); no public substituter by default [shape §9, shift §9-10, prac §20]

13 Distribution: in-repo release-coupled flake first, by-name-ready package.nix so nixpkgs submission is a copy (owner Q3), generated-flake -bin is a third channel never replacing the source build [cod §11-12, gen §12, map M3]

14 IFD: canon's 'pure-eval forbids IFD' contradicted by measurement (devenv builds during pure nix eval); B/C/D and nixpkgs-bound flakes MUST pass --option allow-import-from-derivation false; A may IFD only when its builder requires it, commented [runs Axis 3 Axis 6, canon survey 3, cod §11, prac §8]

15 Era rows: lazy copies (CppNix 2.35) vs lazy trees (Determinate) vs Lix plan are three mechanisms; self.submodules/lfs exist since 2.27 (fail §3 stale); 2.19 flake update, 2.30 profile add; cargoSha256/fetchCargoVendor 25.05; CGO 25.11; x86_64-darwin measured dropped; 2.32 check skips substitutables; magic-nix-cache died then revived; flake-checker binary branch list overrides its README [shift §1 §5 §9, runs Axis 4, shape Contradictions, fail, prac §19-20]

16 ocx fetch: FOD outputHash is the OCI layer digest in SRI form (no prefetch); SAS URL never recorded; builtins and header-less fetchurl ruled out; try fetchurl with Bearer QQ== header, then curl token-exchange FOD, then skopeo; if none builds, ADR asks for a stable blob URL [ocx §3, gen §1 §9]

17 Generation architecture: committed data + reader + CI updater, generator is ocx code (subcommand reusing platform.rs:416 and the registry client); per-project emission is a later UX layer; eval-time index reader only viable if the index publishes layer digests (M-E-29) [gen Summary, shape §11, ocx §5 smell 4, cod Summary]

18 Attribute shape: packages.SYSTEM.NS-PKG = latest; legacyPackages.SYSTEM.NS.PKG."VERSION" holds versions and float aliases without recurseForDerivations; overlay adds final.ocx.NS.PKG [ocx §1.3-1.4, map M3, cod §7, gen]

19 Formatter census: shape's name-grep (20/37) vs runs' formatter-output read (9/36 declare) resolved to runs: ~75% expose no formatter; missing formatter is a SHOULD finding for A/D/E [shape §7, runs Axis 5]

20 rec and with narrowed: mkDerivation rec { is a SHOULD finding (use finalAttrs); plain rec {} is CONSIDER unless self-shadowing; with at file/module scope SHOULD; list-scoped with pkgs; [ ] tolerated [shape §4, canon, cod, fail §8]

21 flake-checker is an advisory CLI step for A/D flakes with a root nixpkgs input, wrapped to separate crashes (Error: Invalid( / Error: FlakeLock() from findings; never a MUST gate [cod §8, fail §9, runs Axis 4, gen]
22 Frame's 2,011 stored image indexes corrected to measured 1,720 (125 packages / 98 namespaces agree) [ocx §1.2]

rules: nix-quality: paths **/*.nix, **/flake.lock, **/statix.toml; index nix-quality.md (NIX-CORE, gate block, era-first, shape-first, routing table); depth files flakes.md (NIX-FLK), inputs.md (NIX-INP), packaging.md (NIX-PKG), generated-flakes.md (NIX-GEN), gates.md (NIX-GATE), release.md (NIX-REL), language.md (NIX-LANG), security.md (NIX-SEC), modules.md (NIX-MOD, conditional on wave 4); .envrc, workflow files, treefmt.toml and README install blocks routed by task, never globbed; checker root nix-community__disko
skills: nix-flake-adopt: add or modernize a flake in an existing repo (shape, package.nix with real hashes, skeleton, devShell, formatter/checks, git add, gate, CI job, README block)
nix-flake-release: gate + all-systems + build and implementation legs, version sync, lock policy, tag, verify nix run of the tag from a clean store, optional cache/FlakeHub push and nixpkgs bump
nix-diagnose: verbatim error string -> cause -> first command -> fix, including checker limitations that are not defects
artifact_set.ocx_handoff: Three parts. (1) Research artifact: the wave-2 consolidation nix-generated-flakes.md with the prototype fixtures copied into nix-generated-flakes/prototype/. (2) A working prototype generator plus flake that builds 2-3 real index packages (actionlint, ninja-build/ninja, one env/entrypoint package) with the local toolchain, produced by wave-2 dives oci-fetch-prototype and index-data-model; if no fetch path builds, the wave-3 contingency dive generated-flakes/fetch-fallback prototypes the minimum index/ocx change. (3) An ADR draft for ocx-sh/ocx (adr_nix_flake_generation.md) written at authoring time that must decide: generator location (ocx subcommand reusing platform.rs:416 and the registry client), repo name and ownership of the generated flake, fetch mechanism and whether ocx/index must provide a stable blob URL or a resolved projection with layer digests, attribute shape and version/alias rules, libc-to-derivation template, license and sourceProvenance mapping plus unmapped-license policy, signature verification beyond digests, update cadence/token/review model and yanked handling, supported systems. The portable subset ships as rules/nix-quality/generated-flakes.md with ocx as the worked example.
artifact_set.rationale: No Nix rule, skill or bundle exists in the catalog (map M2), and flake.nix is both code and manifest, so one rule on the three globs that cannot miss (the language extension, the Nix-required flake.lock, and statix's Nix-only config name) with eight task-routed depth files avoids a second rule loading on the same edits. Procedures (adopt, release, diagnose) are skills; generating flakes from an index is a design pattern plus ocx product code, so it is a depth file and an ADR handoff, not a skill. Bundle nix-essentials carries nix-quality, nix-flake-adopt, nix-flake-release, nix-diagnose, all untagged. Out of scope: NixOS system config, home-manager dotfiles, deploy tools, Hydra, daemon admin beyond CI version floors, container image building, NixOS VM tests, Guix, Cargo/pyproject/Go semantics, README prose, Bazel rules_nixpkgs.

owner_questions: Q1 Publish fleet flakes to FlakeHub? Default: no; releases are the existing vX.Y.Z git tags, and fleet flakes take no FlakeHub inputs.
Q2 Run a public binary cache for fleet flakes? Default: none in v1; CI uses a GitHub-Actions store cache, and READMEs point at the generated flake's prebuilt package as the fast path.
Q3 Upstream ocx and grim to nixpkgs? Default: write every package.nix by-name-ready now; propose to nixpkgs after each CLI's first stable release, outside this program.
Q4 Where does the generated flake live and who owns it? Default: new repo ocx-sh/ocx-nix, generated by CI from ocx-sh/index, generator implemented as an ocx subcommand; the ADR confirms.
Q5 Scope of the generated set? Default: every package and every distinct digest, never pruned until the data file passes 20 MB, then a rolling window; packages carries latest only.
Q6 Implementation promise? Default: CppNix supported and gated; Lix an advisory CI leg; Determinate Nix untested but never deliberately broken.

Q7 Will any fleet flake export a NixOS or home-manager module (e.g. programs.ocx)? Default: none planned; wave 4 researches modules at low priority and modules.md ships only if its rows pass selection.
Q8 Minimum Nix version promised to consumers? Default: the oldest non-stub nixVersions.nix_2_* in the pinned nixpkgs (today 2.31, the version nixpkgs 26.11's own throw recommends).
